title: Coefficient enlargement induction for fixed parameters
statement: With k,A,Lambda,alpha,q,N>0,hpower,a generating the singular ideal,c>0, the polynomial presentation of A, the flat polynomial chart phi0,psi0 and the local Artinian coefficient solution D0,g0 of the parent statement, set n=N+d(8c), P=k[y:Fin m0], p0=phi0 inverse image q, B=P/p0^n, L=Lambda_q and K=m_L^n. Now FIX uP:Fin d to P in p0, generating p0 P_(p0), with the images phi0(uP_i) forming a regular sequence in L; no embedding-dimension equality is assumed. There exist tLambda_i outside q and ell_ij in Lambda with (phi0(uP_i)tLambda_i)^(2N)=sum ell_ij alpha(a_j), and equal first and square multiplication kernels in Lambda modulo preceding (8c)-th powers. There is a local Artinian coefficient algebra D:Type(max u v), compatibly a k- and B-algebra, essentially smooth over B, with a k-map A to D, a flat local map g:D to L/K, units delta_i lifting tLambda_i, and coefficients lifting ell_ij. The B-map and A-map commute with the canonical maps to L/K, exactly as in the attached Lean signature. No polynomial parameter selection, reindexing, polynomial kernel claim, or S-algebra structure is asserted.

proof.text: The flat local Artinian coefficient map is faithfully flat and injective. Lift the images of the finite presentation generators of A to D0. The commuting quotient diagram checks scalar compatibility; injectivity checks all presentation relations, giving A to D0.

Induct on i while retaining all previous factors, coefficients and kernel claims. In the current coefficient ring, faithful-flat contraction writes the residue of phi0(uP_i)^N as sum a_j d_j. Lift d_j to L. The error in m_L^n lies in m_L^(n-N) times the singular ideal, because hpower and n>=N imply m_L^n=m_L^(n-N)m_L^N. Write it as sum a_j cprime_j with cprime_j in m_L^(n-N). Multiplication by phi0(uP_i)^N makes all correction residues zero and gives an exact 2N-th-power relation with coefficient residues in the current ring.

For coefficients w_j choose a common denominator s0 outside q with w_j=v_j/s0, then s1 outside q killing the cleared equation error. Set s=s0*s1 and mu_j=s^(2N-1)*s1*v_j. Direct multiplication gives (s*phi0(uP_i))^(2N)=sum mu_j*alpha(a_j) in Lambda and mu_j/s^(2N)=w_j in L. Use 07FI to include s^r for some r>0 in an essentially smooth coefficient enlargement, replacing s by s^r and mu_j by s^(2N(r-1))*mu_j. The equations persist. Their residues are (s^r)^(2N) times residues of w_j, hence lie in the coefficient ring.

Powers of preceding parameters followed by the current parameter are regular in L by hsequence. Ogoma gives a clearing factor whose every positive power equalizes first and square kernels on the corresponding Lambda quotient. Use 07FI again to include a positive power of this factor, multiply s by it, and multiply mu_j by its 2N-th power. This gives tLambda_i, ell_ij and both required coefficient memberships. Earlier conditions persist through the enlargements. Locality of the coefficient map makes every lift of tLambda_i a unit.

The finite tower is essentially smooth over the localization of B=P/p0^n, and hence over B by composition with localization. For a small model, express the smooth finite-presentation B-algebra as a quotient of a finite polynomial B-algebra. Since the resulting coefficient ring is local and a localization of that model, it is the localization at the inverse image of its maximal ideal. Both the finite polynomial quotient and that localization are in Type(max u v). Transport the coefficient maps, local and flat properties, units and identities along the resulting algebra equivalence. For d=0 retain D0 and its lifted A-map, and perform the same small-model replacement.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_popescu_coefficient_induction
    {k : Type u} {A : Type v} {Λ : Type w}
    [Field k] [CommRing A] [CommRing Λ] [Algebra k A] [Algebra k Λ]
    [FinitePresentation k A] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p)
    (α : A →ₐ[k] Λ) (q : PrimeSpectrum Λ)
    (hreg : IsGeometricallyRegular k Λ)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (hpower : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ N ≤
      (Ideal.map α.toRingHom (singularIdeal k A)).map
        (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)))
    (d : ℕ)
    (s : ℕ) (a : Fin s → A) (ha : Ideal.span (Set.range a) = singularIdeal k A)
    (c : ℕ) (hc : 0 < c)
    (r : ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin r) k →ₐ[k] A) (hf : Function.Surjective f)
    (m₀ : ℕ) (φ₀ : MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k →ₐ[k] Λ)
    (ψ₀ : Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) →+*
      Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)
    (hψ₀ : ψ₀.comp (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom))) =
      (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)).comp φ₀.toRingHom)
    (hideal₀ : q.asIdeal.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)) =
      (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map
        ((algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)).comp φ₀.toRingHom))
    (hflat₀ : ψ₀.Flat)
    (D₀ : Type (max u w)) [CommRing D₀] [IsLocalRing D₀] [IsArtinianRing D₀]
    [Algebra (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) ⧸
      ((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^ (N + d * (8 * c))) D₀]
    (g₀ : D₀ →+* Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal ⧸
      (q.asIdeal.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))) ^
        (N + d * (8 * c)))
    [IsLocalHom (algebraMap (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) ⧸
      ((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^
          (N + d * (8 * c))) D₀)]
    [IsLocalHom g₀]
    (hsmooth₀ : EssentiallySmooth
      (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) ⧸
        ((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
          (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^
            (N + d * (8 * c))) D₀)
    (hgflat₀ : g₀.Flat)
    (hfactor₀ : (g₀.comp (algebraMap
      (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom) ⧸
        ((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
          (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^
            (N + d * (8 * c))) D₀)).comp
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk (((q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
          (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)))) ^
            (N + d * (8 * c)))) =
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk ((q.asIdeal.map
        (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))) ^
          (N + d * (8 * c)))).comp ψ₀)
    (hinc₀ : ∀ i : Fin r, Ideal.Quotient.mk
      ((q.asIdeal.map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal))) ^
        (N + d * (8 * c)))
      (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (α (f (MvPolynomial.X i)))) ∈
        Set.range g₀)
    (uP : Fin d → MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
    (huP : ∀ i, uP i ∈ q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)
    (hspan : Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i ↦
      algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
        (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom)) (uP i))) =
      (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom).map
        (algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k)
          (Localization.AtPrime (q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom))))
    (hsequence : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)
      (List.ofFn (fun i ↦ algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (φ₀ (uP i))))) :
    let P := MvPolynomial (Fin m₀) k
    let p₀ := q.asIdeal.comap φ₀.toRingHom
    let B := P ⧸ p₀ ^ (N + d * (8 * c))
    let L := Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal
    let K := IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal L ^ (N + d * (8 * c))
    ∃ (tΛ : Fin d → Λ) (ell : Fin d × Fin s → Λ),
      (∀ i, tΛ i ∉ q.asIdeal) ∧
      (∀ i, (φ₀ (uP i) * tΛ i) ^ (2 * N) =
        ∑ j : Fin s, ell (i, j) * α (a j)) ∧
      (∀ (i : Fin d)
        (x : Λ ⧸ Ideal.span {y | ∃ j : Fin d, j.val < i.val ∧
          y = (φ₀ (uP j) * tΛ j) ^ (c * 8)}),
        (φ₀ (uP i) * tΛ i) • x = 0 ↔ (φ₀ (uP i) * tΛ i) ^ 2 • x = 0) ∧
      ∃ (D : Type (max u v)) (_ : CommRing D) (_ : IsLocalRing D)
        (_ : IsArtinianRing D) (_ : Algebra k D) (_ : Algebra B D)
        (_ : IsScalarTower k B D),
        EssentiallySmooth B D ∧
        ∃ (f₀ : A →ₐ[k] D) (g : D →+* L ⧸ K)
          (δ : Fin d → Dˣ) (coeff : Fin d × Fin s → D),
          IsLocalRing (L ⧸ K) ∧ IsLocalHom g ∧ g.Flat ∧
          (∀ z : P, g (algebraMap B D (Ideal.Quotient.mk (p₀ ^ (N + d * (8 * c))) z)) =
            Ideal.Quotient.mk K (algebraMap Λ L (φ₀ z))) ∧
          (∀ i, g (δ i : D) = Ideal.Quotient.mk K (algebraMap Λ L (tΛ i))) ∧
          (∀ x, g (f₀ x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk K (algebraMap Λ L (α x))) ∧
          (∀ ij, g (coeff ij) = Ideal.Quotient.mk K (algebraMap Λ L (ell ij)))
